To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reliability design of steel structures in accordance with the EUROCODE is a very complex process, which is influenced by many parameters, such as material characteristics, load action, partial safety factors, etc., and that the EUROCODE is not sufficiently precise in the definition of partial safety factors.
the failure probabilities of steel structures designed in the Czech Republic and Austria differ significantly.
the differences in failure probability of the steel members of Czech manufacturing are higher than the differences in failure prob ability of the steel members produced in Austria.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the probabilistic reliability analysis and fuzzy probabilistic analysis of steel structures designed according to EURO CODE.
the verification of reliability of steel members of both Czech and Aust rian production designed according to the European standard EN1990.
the reliability of steel structure members in connection with the fuzzy probabilistic analysis of yield stress.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reliability design concept of EUROCODE is not suitable to ensure the quality of steel production.

the EUROCODE 3 standard provides an acceptable level of reliability of the load-carrying structures, and that there is a possibility to improve the reliability by a suitable adjustment of safety factors of load action and of load-carry ing capacity.
the reliability design concept of the Eurocodes is suitable for the design of steel members of the Czech and Austrian production, but the values of partial safety factors are in some cases too low.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the differences in the yield strength of steel S235 produced in Czech and Austrian steelworks have an impact on the failure probability of steel members.
the differences in failure probabilities of Czech and Austrian structural steel members can be considered negligible.
the reliability design of steel structures in the EU countries should be based on the same safety level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reliability of steel structures can be significantly affected by the quality of steel production.

a significant difference exists in the reliability of steel structures designed according to the EUROCODE 3, which is caused by the difference in the yield stress distribution in the production of steel.
the partial safety factors of the load-carrying capacities are too small.
